title: The Autonomous Revolution: Artificial Intelligence and the Future of the Automotive Industry
description: A guide to AI in the automotive industry — autonomous vehicles, predictive maintenance, smart manufacturing, and how artificial intelligence is reshaping personal mobility.
short_description: A grounded look at AI in the automotive industry, covering what works, what wobbles, and what matters in practice.
author: Jonathan Harris
audience: A clear, no-hype briefing on AI in the automotive industry for operators, planners, analysts, product teams, and readers tracking mobility systems.
